india-macro.title: Weakest monsoon since 2015 prompts ICRA to cut FY27 farm growth forecast
india-macro.summary: In 2026, the Southwest monsoon recorded rainfall at 87 percent of the long-period average, the lowest since 2015. Reservoir storage levels have significantly declined, raising concerns for the upcoming rabi season.
